summary: RREEF Property Trust, Inc., a Maryland REIT, filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to declare monthly distributions for August 2026 across eight classes of common stock. Gross distribution is $0.07495 per share across classes, with net amounts varying from $0.06350 (Class A) to $0.07495 (Class D, M-I, N, Z) after deducting dealer manager and distribution fees. The record date is September 1, 2026, with payment on September 2, 2026. This is a routine distribution announcement not constituting a special situation. No deal terms, strategic actions, or unusual corporate events are disclosed. Watch for nothing extraordinary; this is a regular operational filing.
